# ledger_categories (Data Source)

Lists Ledger categories, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The active children of one category.
data "ledger_categories" "housing_children" {
  parent_id = data.ledger_category.housing.id
  archived  = false
}

output "child_names" {
  value = [for c in data.ledger_categories.housing_children.items : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Only archived (`true`) or only active (`false`) ones. Both are listed when unset.
- `name_prefix` (String) Only names starting with this text, ignoring case.
- `parent_id` (String) Only the children of this category, or `none` for the top-level categories.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching categories, in creation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether it is archived.
- `archived_at` (String) When it was archived (RFC 3339, UTC), or null.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) The Ledger identifier.
- `name` (String) The name.
- `parent_id` (String) The parent category's identifier, or null for a top-level category.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `version` (Number) The optimistic-concurrency version.
